ACT XXX OF 2021
PUNJAB PRIVATIZATION BOARD
(REPEAL) ACT, 2021
An Act to repeal the Punjab Privatization
Board Act, 2010
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
1st October, 2021]
No.
PAP/Legis-2(89)/2020/2639, dated 1.10.2021.---The Punjab Privatization Board (Repeal) Bill, 2020, having been passed
by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on September 27, 2021, and assented to
by the Governor of the Punjab on October 01, 2021, is hereby published as an
Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
It
is necessary to repeal the Punjab Privatization Board Act, 2010 (IV of 2010)
for the purposes hereinafter appearing.
Be it enacted by Provincial Assembly of
the Punjab as follows:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be cited as the Punjab Privatization Board (Repeal) Act, 2021.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

Repeal and saving

[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,

No.
PAP/Legis-2(89)/2020/2639, dated 1.10.2021.---The Punjab Privatization Board (Repeal) Bill, 2020, having been passed
by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on September 27, 2021, and assented to
by the Governor of the Punjab on October 01, 2021, is hereby published as an
Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
It
is necessary to repeal the Punjab Privatization Board Act, 2010 (IV of 2010)
for the purposes hereinafter appearing.
Be it enacted by Provincial Assembly of
the Punjab as follows:
2. Repeal
and saving.---(1) The Punjab
Privatization Board Act, 2010 (IV of 2010) is hereby repealed.
(2) Notwithstanding
the repeal of the Punjab Privatization Board Act, 2010 (IV of 2010), all the
proceedings and processes pertaining to privatization of the Government
properties, initiated or completed, assessment of prices of properties made,
auctions done, sanction orders issued, any appointment made, order passed,
notification issued, contracts executed, rights acquired, liabilities incurred,
possession of properties delivered and proceedings initiated before various
courts or other forums and things done or action taken under any provision of
the repealed Act shall continue to have effect unless repealed, recalled,
withdrawn or cancelled.

Transition

Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
It
is necessary to repeal the Punjab Privatization Board Act, 2010 (IV of 2010)
for the purposes hereinafter appearing.
Be it enacted by Provincial Assembly of
the Punjab as follows:
3. Transition.---(1) All the properties, both urban and rural,
including agricultural land, whether occupied and unoccupied, placed at the
disposal of defunct Punjab Privatization Board, which may be available for
disposal immediately before the repeal of the aforesaid Act, shall stand
transferred to the Colonies Department, Board of Revenue, Punjab.
(2) The
Secretary and other employees of the defunct Punjab Privatization Board,
whether permanent or contractual, shall stand transferred to the Colonies
Department, Board of Revenue, Punjab.
(3) All
the moveable assets of defunct Punjab Privatization Board shall stand
transferred to Colonies Department, Board of Revenue, Punjab.
